# Maturity of the modules

<!-- generated by tools/maturity_table.py from validation/maturity.yaml: do not edit -->

For every module a user sees, the strongest evidence that it is right, the tests that
give it, and what is not covered yet, grouped by the themes of the documentation.
Built from the tests of the repository (the `literature` unit tests,
`validation/tests/*.rs`, the specifications with `expect`, the Python tests); the
source is `validation/maturity.yaml`, to update when a validation is added.

**Levels.**

- **A** — validated against an external reference: a published figure or table, a
  table of a standard reproduced verbatim, or the recorded output of a reference
  implementation (OptiCommPy 0.11, GNPy 3.0, AFF3CT v4.7.1) on the same inputs.
- **B** — against a closed form only.
- **C** — self-consistency only: round trips, invariants, comparisons between the
  blocks of the library.
- **—** — not validated.

A level says what is checked, not that every regime is: the last column lists the
regimes and references not covered, from the statuses "needed" and "next" of
[`references/README.md`](../references/README.md); the comparisons with every document
are in [`LITERATURE.md`](LITERATURE.md). Tests marked "ignored" run with
`cargo test --release -p com-validation -- --ignored`, by hand or by the workflow
`validation.yml` started by hand (never automatically); the others run on every push.
A specification run "on demand" is checked by `comrs verify <file>` (`just validate`
for `specs/validation/`).

Summary: 60 modules: 52 at A, 4 at B, 4 at C.
